name: The Go To Market Handbook For B2B SaaS Leaders
tagline: A practical guide for founders and revenue leaders who want to scale their business with clarity and confidence.
description:
This book has been written for people we regard as heroes.
There are few people we admire more than the Founders and Leaders of software companies who have the courage, determination and, some might say, sheer madness to put their livelihoods and reputation on the line, to leave their own ‘dent in the universe’. It's a day to day, up at dawn, pride swallowing siege to lead such a business. And we know this for a fact because we’ve walked in your shoes many times. 
Over the last 25 years, we’ve been involved in the start-up, scale up and exit of several successful technology businesses, that between them have realised close to billion dollars of shareholder value. But along the way we've also had more than our fair share of disappointments and have the mental scars and bruising to prove it. We’ve made mistakes and fallen in what felt like bottomless pits. But fascinatingly enough, we learned as much from the ones that didn’t work, as we did from the successes. It’s these lessons which we thought we'd share in this book.
So why have we embarked on this journey? Well having sat in your chair many times, we can tell you that being the leader of a B2B SaaS business can be a lonely place. The army call it the loneliness of leadership and take great steps to ensure their officers are constantly communicated with, encouraged, and sustained. 
But in the world of technology, there’s little help available. Unlike our greatest sportsmen, many of our leading SaaS Founders don’t have an experienced support team around them, looking after every aspect of their well-being. They have to carry the load alone. The three of us were lucky as we’ve always had each other, and I can’t tell you the number of times we’ve talked each other of various high ledges!
For many though, the challenge is who to turn to when things aren’t going to plan.
